title: Assemble a clean fixture
question: What support does the Pro plan include?

title: Lower the budget until optional content is omitted
question: What support does the Pro plan include?
description: The same candidates as step 3 with budget.input lowered from 600 to 170. The droppable user state goes first. Then compressible items are reduced in the route's fitting order: the supplied summaries replace the Enterprise and Pro chunks, both prior turns are omitted (history sheds before evidence on this route), and the lowest-ranked chunk, Free, is omitted. Every replacement is a compressed row and every omission an over_budget row.
proves: Tier order, supplied variants and the route's fitting order. Nothing is truncated; every reduction is recorded.

title: Lower it further until protected content cannot fit
question: What support does the Pro plan include?
description: budget.input is below what the instructions and the query need on their own. Assembly refuses with protected_content_over_budget: result is null, nothing is included, and the admission decisions stay in the trace.
proves: Protected content is never truncated, and a refusal never becomes a model request.
